title: FoodRecipeSuggestRequest
description: food.recipe-suggest-request@1: POST /api/v1/recipes/suggest. Asks OpenVibe.AI's food.suggest_recipes workflow for up to three recipes from the caller's saved pantry (an empty pantry is 422 food.pantry_empty). 10 a person a day (429 food.recipes_daily_limit); with Food's AI connection off, 503 food.ai_off.
